branches.name: teacher_consistency
branches.idea: keep strong optical teacher, tighten SAR-to-teacher consistency, and bias the frontend toward teacher-aligned latent structure
branches.expected_signal: better candidate purity, lower drift, minimal architectural churn

branches.name: sar_structure_stem
branches.idea: strengthen SAR structural cue extraction with log/edge/texture channels and a stronger residual stem
branches.expected_signal: higher SAR-side selectivity and less energy-collapse

branches.name: common_unique_split
branches.idea: separate shared/common representation from modality-specific residuals, then let matcher consume the common latent first
branches.expected_signal: better cross-modal invariance without erasing modality-specific cues

branches.name: masked_cross_modal_pretrain
branches.idea: add masked reconstruction / modality dropout / cross-modal prediction so one side learns to recover the other
branches.expected_signal: stronger global semantic alignment and more robust patch evidence
